name: Shelly 2PM Gen3 (EU)

radios.note: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi; Bluetooth is for setup and as a gateway for Shelly BLU devices.

matter.note: CSA lists Shelly 2PM Gen3 (certified 2025-05-21, Matter 1.3, Wi-Fi). Shelly's FAQ says Matter needs firmware 1.6.0 or later, so update before pairing.

apple_home.note: Through Matter once on firmware 1.6.0 or later. Shelly's page doesn't list Apple Home by name. Needs an Apple home hub for remote use.

google_home.note: Through Matter. Shelly's page also lists Google Smart Home without saying how, so only Matter is claimed.

alexa.note: Shelly's page lists Amazon Alexa. It can also be added through Matter.

smartthings.note: Through Matter. Shelly's page also lists SmartThings; the route is not stated.

home_assistant.note: Official Shelly integration with local push, covering Shelly generations. It can also be added through Matter.

hubRequired.note: Wi-Fi device with a built-in web interface; no hub needed.

localControl.note: Shelly lists a web interface, HTTP API, MQTT, scripting and webhooks; Home Assistant's integration uses local push.

switchForm.note: 37 x 42 x 16 mm relay for a wall box, behind a switch or socket.

dimmer.note: Shelly calls it a Wi-Fi relay ('WLAN Relais') with power metering and describes no dimming. It also has a cover (roller shutter, blind) mode.

neutralRequired.note: The supply terminals are N and L, and Shelly's wiring diagrams include a neutral. It can also run on 24 V DC.

gangs.note: Two relay outputs with power measurement per channel and two switch inputs. 10 A per channel, 16 A total, at up to 240 V AC.

summary: Two relay channels with power metering per channel, or one cover channel for a shutter or blind motor: that is the Shelly 2PM Gen3, fitted behind an existing switch. It needs a neutral wire and has no dimming. Matter over Wi-Fi covers Apple Home, Google Home and SmartThings once it's on firmware 1.6.0 or later, Alexa is listed on Shelly's page, and Home Assistant has a local integration.
caveats: Needs a neutral wire at the box.
Matter needs firmware 1.6.0 or later; the CSA entry itself shows firmware 1.3.0-s2.
Rated 10 A per channel and 16 A total, so two heavy loads can exceed the total.
Shelly's page doesn't list Apple Home by name; it works only through Matter.
